title: EvaluationResult in-toto predicate v1
description: The signed outcome of one evaluation run over a named system. Evidence of what was measured and when. Not a certification, not a ranking, and not a claim that the result generalises.

evaluatedAt.description: RFC 3339, UTC, when the run completed. Not when the attestation was signed.

harness.description: The evaluation code, pinned. A version alone is not a pin: releases get retagged.

commit.description: Full 40-hex commit. Truncated prefixes are rejected: a prefix is not an identifier.

items.description: The item set actually scored, pinned by digest so a reader can tell whether two runs scored the same things.

heldOut.description: True only if the item set was sequestered from the system under test. Absent means unknown, which is not the same as false.

grading.description: A model judge is not deterministic grading and must not be presented as such.

interval.description: Wilson is defined for 0/1 proportion metrics under a mean aggregation ONLY. A proportion interval does not describe a median.

contamination.description: Silence here is not a clean bill. An absent field means the question was not asked.

establishes.description: What this result supports, in the issuer's own words.

doesNotEstablish.description: What a reader must not infer. Required by the review rule that a claim not stated is not assumed.
